objective.economic_engine: Domestic equity earnings, cash-flow realization, distributions and valuation change; defensive sleeves do not manufacture the hurdle.

scope.investor_assumption: Research default only: at least five-year horizon, domestic securities access, and tolerance for equity and rate-asset volatility. Personal eligibility, liquidity needs, taxes, fees and risk capacity are not verified.
scope.research_universe_policy: Open across domestic public products, but this version has a closed five-ETF operating candidate set.
scope.exclusion_meaning: Version boundary only, not a permanent research-universe exclusion.

product_roles.name: Huatai-PineBridge CSI 300 ETF
product_roles.key_boundary: Equity exposure, not a whole-market, low-volatility, execution or return guarantee.

product_roles.name: Huatai-PineBridge SSE Dividend ETF
product_roles.key_boundary: Dividend style is equity risk, not fixed income or a distinct hedge from 510300.

product_roles.name: Guotai SSE 5-Year Treasury Bond ETF
product_roles.key_boundary: Secondary-market price, NAV and IOPV are distinct; rate, premium-discount and liquidity risk remain.

product_roles.name: Huaan Gold ETF
product_roles.key_boundary: No operating cash flow or coupon; it is not an automatic equity or bond hedge.

product_roles.name: Huabao Cash Tianyi ETF Class A
product_roles.key_boundary: Money-market exposure, not account cash, a return floor, or a same-day availability conclusion.

operating_rule.observation_schedule: After close on the final common session of March, June, September and December.
operating_rule.earliest_effective_session: Next common session after the observation close.
operating_rule.rebalance_trigger: At least one absolute actual-weight deviation is strictly greater than 5 percentage points.
operating_rule.hard_failure_action: NO_ACTION or operational_pause; no substitution, assumed fill, same-day close fill or invented exit price.
operating_rule.same_day_roundtrip: prohibited unless a future version has product-, venue-, account- and settlement-specific evidence.

forward_paper_ledger.normalization_basis: A reconciled normalized paper-unit index, not an investor amount. Actual weights must be reconstructed from recorded paper units and same-timestamp valuation marks.
forward_paper_ledger.portfolio_reconstruction_rule: For each recorded cycle, actual weight equals the product paper-unit value divided by the aggregate recorded paper-unit value; missing unit, mark, distribution/event or reconciliation evidence forces NO_ACTION.

risk_controls.amber_action: Independent review before next scheduled cycle; do not revise weights or claim a stop-loss execution.
risk_controls.red_action: operational_pause pending independent review; no forced exit at an unverified price.

known_boundaries.c30_static_price_proxy: not an admission basis; five complete calendar years were below the 5% research line.
known_boundaries.c34_dynamic_price_proxy: not an admission basis; seven complete calendar years and 43 of 98 rolling-five-year endpoints were below the 5% research line.
known_boundaries.futures: C16/C17 actual-contract diagnostics did not provide a usable return route; futures remain zero weight.
known_boundaries.options: C51/C52 do not provide historical chain, execution, cost or account evidence; no option income route is admitted.
known_boundaries.reverse_repo: C50 did not establish a 5% yield floor; it is not a return engine.

admission_requirements: Rights-cleared point-in-time total-return, distribution, event, quote, depth, status, fee, tax and settlement data.
Six uninterrupted complete quarterly paper cycles without changing products, weights, bands, thresholds or cadence.
Independent reconstruction of every target, price-protection and exception branch.
Net-total-return disclosure for complete calendar years, rolling five-year periods, drawdown, worst contiguous period, non-fill rate and all recorded friction.

decision.next_research_priority: Validate the equity return engine through the separately preregistered C39 audited-cash-flow route and a rights-cleared ETF total-return and execution package.
